note.after_visit_summary: You have moderate acne on your face and back, along with some dark spots from past breakouts. We are starting three treatments: adapalene 0.1% gel at night (every other night for two weeks, then nightly), doxycycline 100 mg twice daily for three months, and benzoyl peroxide 4% wash each morning. Take doxycycline with food and a full glass of water, stay upright for 30 minutes after, and avoid dairy, calcium, or iron for two hours before and after. Use white towels with benzoyl peroxide to avoid bleaching concerns. Both adapalene and doxycycline make your skin more sensitive to the sun, so use SPF 30 or higher sunscreen every morning and wear a hat if you are outside a lot. Stop the medication and call us if you get a bad sunburn, severe stomach upset, or headaches with vision changes. If you think you might be pregnant, stop both adapalene and doxycycline and call us right away, as these can harm a developing baby. Continue your birth control pill and vitamin D as usual. Improvement takes time—expect to see full effect in 8 to 12 weeks. Return for follow-up in 3 months.
